name: google-surf-mcp
description: Web, academic and code search with graph RAG, data lineage, ontology and cross-project schema links.
long_description: Google Surf combines browser-based web search, content extraction, Scholar metadata, and codebase retrieval through search, search_parallel, and extract. Research mode is enabled by default and stores results in a local graph hybrid RAG with evidence-backed data lineage, versioned ontology, and precision-first schema linking across selected projects. Exact, BM25, vector, graph, and live web candidates are fused with RRF and one shared reranker. GitHub READMEs are read directly and one eligible small repository per call can be indexed automatically. Browser search needs no API key. SearchApi is an optional primary or fallback provider.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Always performs live web search for new external information, with optional extraction and graph hybrid RAG over stored project knowledge.

tools.name: scholar_search
tools.description: Paper metadata only: authors, venue, year, versions, citations, provider provenance, and related prior-search context.

tools.name: search_parallel
tools.description: Always performs 2-12 live web searches for new external information with one extraction budget and optional graph hybrid RAG.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Read one known page, paper, PDF, or repository URL and optionally store it as provenance-linked searchable evidence.

tools.name: project_memory_search
tools.description: Search stored local project knowledge in one broker request with batched query variants, exact, BM25, vector, evidence-seeded graph expansion, RRF, and one local rerank.

tools.name: project_memory
tools.description: Manage projects, sessions, plans, experiments, decisions, ontology, lineage, rebuilds, exports, corrections, and reversible deletion.

tools.name: health
tools.description: MCP server status: cascade mode, rate-limiter usage, cache size, config. Call when searches start failing.

search_api_key.title: SearchApi API key
search_api_key.description: Required only for SearchApi primary or fallback modes.

browser_engine.title: Browser engine
browser_engine.description: auto, native, or playwright. Auto uses one hidden native Chrome broker shared across local MCP sessions.

chrome_path.title: Chrome binary path
chrome_path.description: Absolute path to the Chrome/Chromium binary. Auto-detected when blank.

profile_root.title: Profile directory
profile_root.description: Directory for the warm Chrome profile. Defaults to ~/.google-surf-mcp.

research.title: Local research memory
research.description: Enable local project memory, capture, indexing, project_memory_search, and project_memory.

retrieval_mode.title: Research retrieval mode
retrieval_mode.description: live uses the web provider only. hybrid combines live and project retrieval.

research_root.title: Research data directory
research_root.description: Embedded SurrealDB data directory. Defaults to <profile>/research.

research_vector_model.title: Research vector model
research_vector_model.description: Local Hugging Face model for HNSW retrieval and shared reranking. Use off to disable.

research_vector_low_memory.title: Low-memory vector runtime
research_vector_low_memory.description: Disable the ONNX CPU memory arena and memory pattern to reduce peak memory.

research_vector_threads.title: Vector runtime threads
research_vector_threads.description: ONNX intra-op thread count from 1 to 16.

research_repo_auto.title: Automatic repository indexing
research_repo_auto.description: Sparse-index at most one eligible small GitHub repository per search call.

research_repo_auto_max_mb.title: Repository source size limit
research_repo_auto_max_mb.description: Maximum searchable source-text size in MB. Assets are excluded.

research_repo_auto_max_files.title: Repository source file limit
research_repo_auto_max_files.description: Maximum searchable source file count for automatic indexing.

research_broker_idle_ms.title: Research broker idle lifetime
research_broker_idle_ms.description: Milliseconds to keep the shared research broker available after the last client disconnects.

research_read_concurrency.title: Research read concurrency
research_read_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent broker reads. Identical in-flight reads share one operation.

research_query_timeout_ms.title: Research query timeout
research_query_timeout_ms.description: Embedded SurrealDB query timeout in milliseconds.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Optional token that raises GitHub API limits for repository inspection.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to system tz.

headless.title: Headless
headless.description: Controls Playwright extraction, compatibility, and recovery paths. Native search hides normal system Chrome and shows it only for CAPTCHA recovery.

remote_debug.title: Remote DevTools debug
remote_debug.description: Headless server with remote DevTools. CAPTCHA emits the port and throws; attach chrome://inspect from a local Chrome to solve.

cloud_mode.title: Cloud mode
cloud_mode.description: Headless/serverless: insecure TLS + --no-sandbox + --disable-dev-shm-usage + pool disabled + CAPTCHA fail-fast.

allow_private.title: Allow private addresses
allow_private.description: Allow extract on private/loopback addresses. Default blocks them (SSRF guard).

telemetry.title: Enable telemetry
telemetry.description: Enable jsonl event logging for the self-healing pipeline (search outcomes, cache hits/misses, tool errors, parser staleness). Off by default.

telemetry_root.title: Telemetry directory
telemetry_root.description: Directory for jsonl telemetry files. UTC-dated one file per day (YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl). Defaults to <profileRoot>/telemetry.

llm_heal.title: LLM-assisted repair
llm_heal.description: Enable the optional workflow-only LLM selector repair path.

llm_model.title: LLM repair model
llm_model.description: Optional model override. OrcaRouter defaults to orcarouter/auto.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Used only by the optional Anthropic repair provider.

orcarouter_api_key.title: OrcaRouter API key
orcarouter_api_key.description: Used only by the optional OrcaRouter repair provider.
